nativeColourFormula.colourSequence: lerp(shallowColour, waterColour, depthWeight) -> source lighting -> _WaterTintPreFoam -> foam/crud -> _WaterTint

nativeAlpha: Vertex COLOR.r times near-clip fade, optional radial mask and global AntiSphere/fog-field mask. Primary/Shallow/Tint.a and normalizedDepth are not the output opacity. Vertex stage o4.z is linear eye depth, not world height.

webApproximation.scope: Exact M_Water_swamp / GD/Water-GD in map build 25306743 only
webApproximation.shaderFeatures: Source primary/shallow colours and final tint; scene depth uses the source depth weight
webApproximation.shallowApproximation: Uses source Shallow alone because the existing pass has depth but no opaque scene-colour texture
webApproximation.omitted: Secondary noise texture, refraction scene colour, foam/crud, native lighting and vertex alpha are not reproduced
webApproximation.fallback: Primary linear RGB multiplied by WaterTint linear RGB, not an invented colour/opacity

fogCheck.segment3: GLB has M_Water_swamp but no FogSurface; blue rectangle cannot be asserted to be duplicated static FogSurface
fogCheck.segment4: GLB has a single-material FogSurface mesh; exact map-baseline metadata associates fog to segment4
fogCheck.blueRockTop: M_SwampRock_Swampy has source TopColor [.177020311,.228631660,.962264180] sRGB, independent of water
